CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Handball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Handball.

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

6. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

8. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   B. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

9. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

12. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. B — The speed of the music

3. A — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

6. C — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Red, blue, and yellow

8. C — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. D — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. D — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Components of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Drawing and Painting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
